description: Classic textbook example: minimize x^2 + y^2 subject to x+y >= 1. By symmetry of the objective and the constraint, the constrained minimum lies on x=y at the constraint boundary x+y=1, i.e. (0.5, 0.5), fun=0.5 -- derivable independently via Lagrange multipliers (grad f = lambda * grad g at the active constraint).
